Agnes Fenner.narrative: I was born at Coldwell and grew up with the smell of the fields in my nose. Now I cook at the Bell and Bush, and my hands are never idle. Wat is a good man, but he does not understand that Marta is still my sister. I carry food out to her when I can, and I will not let them starve.
goals: Keep Marta and her children fed without Wat finding out
See Bram and Sissly grow up safe
Hold my tongue at the inn when the talk turns to outlaws

relations.name: Wat Fenner
relations.label: husband
relations.note: A good man, but he would not understand about Marta.

relations.name: Marta Hale
relations.label: sister
relations.note: She is my blood; I will not let her starve.

relations.name: Ned Hale
relations.label: brother
relations.note: He was always quick to anger, but he is still my brother.

relations.name: Bram Fenner
relations.label: son
relations.note: My boy, always running to the gate.

relations.name: Sissly Fenner
relations.label: daughter
relations.note: My little shadow in the kitchen.

relations.name: Baldwin Wade
relations.label: employer
relations.note: He pays fair and asks few questions.

relations.name: Petra Wade
relations.label: coworker
relations.note: We work well together, though she watches me sometimes.

relations.name: Sister Elspeth
relations.label: friend
relations.note: She nursed Robin and never judged.

relations.name: Aldwin Hale
relations.label: father by marriage
relations.note: He was my husband's father's name before I ever left Coldwell; he still works the old garden patch and says nothing of the Tolleys, and I bring him what I can.

relations.name: Robin Hale
relations.label: nephew
relations.note: Marta's boy, and he has been coughing since the spring; I passed word to the chapel for him and I would do more if I could.

relations.name: Sayer Hale
relations.label: sister by marriage
relations.note: She carried my word to the chapel and she keeps the common pot at Coldwell; she fears the guards more than the wolves, and I am one of the guards' wives, so she is careful with me.

memories.gist: The day the Reeve's men came to Coldwell and told us the fields were taken; I stood with Marta and watched them ride off.
My wedding to Wat in the chapel, with Marta standing beside me and Ned grinning.
The night Robin had the fever; I ran to fetch Sister Elspeth and she came without a word.
Carrying a basket of bread and cheese out to Coldwell last winter, my heart in my throat lest Wat see me.
Watching Bram play at the gate with the guards' names on his lips, proud as a little soldier.

stances.why: Blood is blood, and Marta is my sister.
If Wat knew, he could lose his post and I could lose everything.
No one should starve, not even outlaws.
I have enough troubles without shouting about them.

Agnes Fenner.secret: I carry food out to Coldwell by the south gate when Wat is not on watch; Marta knows, Wat does not.

Wat Fenner.narrative: I have kept the south gate for seven years, and I know every carter and every load. The due pays our wages and keeps the wolves off the road, but the carters curse me for it. My wife's sister is an outlaw, and that shames me, though I say nothing. I do my duty and I go home.
goals: Keep the gate and the due running smoothly
Keep my post and my family's name clean

relations.name: Agnes Fenner
relations.label: wife
relations.note: She is a good wife, though she worries too much.

relations.name: Bram Fenner
relations.label: son
relations.note: He will be a guard one day, I think.

relations.name: Sissly Fenner
relations.label: daughter
relations.note: She is her mother's girl.

relations.name: Marta Hale
relations.label: sister-in-law
relations.note: She chose the outlaw's life; I cannot respect it.

relations.name: Tobin Marrow
relations.label: captain
relations.note: He is young, but he knows his duty.

relations.name: Silas Pike
relations.label: carter
relations.note: He hates the due, but he pays it.

relations.name: Walter Stanhope
relations.label: fellow guard
relations.note: A good man to have at your back.

relations.name: Edric Grey
relations.label: fellow guard
relations.note: Quiet, but reliable.

relations.name: Aldric Marrow
relations.label: reeve
relations.note: He pays my wage, and the due is what pays it. I'll not bite the hand that feeds my children.

relations.name: Mercy Abbot
relations.label: guild head
relations.note: She would have my due gone and my pay with it. Easy to be generous with another man's livelihood.

relations.name: Kai Ostrander
relations.label: deserter
relations.note: A quay guard who ran from his post and fell in with my wife's sister's lot. No good comes of a man who leaves his duty.

relations.name: Ned Hale
relations.label: brother-in-law
relations.note: My wife's brother, and he does the threatening on the road. If I am sent out with the cart I pray I do not have to face him.

memories.gist: The day I was made a gate guard; Tobin Marrow gave me the badge himself.
The Lean Year, when the carters came with empty wagons and we still had to take the due.
The night Marta came to our door after the fields were taken; I told her she could not stay.
Silas Pike's face when I took the due from him last week; he looked like he wanted to spit.
Bram asking me the names of all the guards, and me telling him every one.

stances.why: The gate must be kept, and the due pays for it.
I will do what I must to keep my family fed.
Outlaws are outlaws, even if they are kin.
I do my job and I do not make a fuss.

Bram Fenner.narrative: I am nine and I can name every guard at the south gate. When I grow up I will be a guard too, and maybe a captain like Tobin Marrow. Mother says I must not go near the woods, but I know the guards' names and they let me watch.
goals: Learn all the guards' names and signals
See a wolf without getting eaten

relations.name: Wat Fenner
relations.label: father
relations.note: He is a guard, and I want to be like him.

relations.name: Agnes Fenner
relations.label: mother
relations.note: She is always busy, but she gives good hugs.

relations.name: Sissly Fenner
relations.label: sister
relations.note: She is little, but she is all right.

relations.name: Marta Hale
relations.label: aunt
relations.note: I do not see her much, but she gave me a wooden horse once.

relations.name: Tobin Marrow
relations.label: captain
relations.note: He is the captain; I want to be like him.

relations.name: Walter Stanhope
relations.label: guard
relations.note: He lets me hold his spear sometimes.

memories.gist: The day my father took me to the gate and showed me how to check a load.
Seeing a wolf at the edge of the woods with my father; he told me to stay close.
Playing with Robin Hale at Coldwell before the trouble; we made mud pies.

stances.why: Guards are brave, and I want to be a guard.
Family is family, even if we do not see them.
I know all the guards' names and I am learning the signals.

Sissly Fenner.narrative: I am six and I follow Mother in the kitchen. It is warm and smells of bread and onions. Sometimes I get to stir the pot. I do not like the woods; they are dark.
goals: Get a taste of the pie filling

relations.name: Agnes Fenner
relations.label: mother
relations.note: She is always there, and she smells of flour.

relations.name: Wat Fenner
relations.label: father
relations.note: He is big and warm when he comes home.

relations.name: Bram Fenner
relations.label: brother
relations.note: He is noisy, but he is my brother.

relations.name: Petra Wade
relations.label: friend
relations.note: She gives me little bits of pastry.

memories.gist: Helping Mother stir the pot at the inn and getting a taste from the spoon.
Being scared of the dark woods when Bram told me there were wolves.
